what_this_is: The first deploy of the Calm Frames AWS stack and the two ingest runs that followed it, on the night of 2026-10-09. Written from read-only describe, list and get calls made between 02:20 and 02:51 PDT the same night, and from the evidence saved during the deploy outside the repository. Every account id, bucket name, distribution domain, ARN, repository URI and email address is left out on purpose.
times_are: Pacific Daylight Time (UTC-7), written as ISO 8601 with the offset
redacted: IAM user, role and session names

checkpoint_d.confirmed_by: Alex, in chat and at his own terminal
checkpoint_d.lock_line_lives_in: docs/STATUS.md of a separate deploy worktree, never committed, so pipeline/tests/test_aws_guard.py keeps the committed lock closed
checkpoint_d.credit_request_clause: void since the credit request form closed on 2026-10-07. Alex waived it; his own AWS credits cover the bill.

deployed_from.checkout: a detached worktree at that commit, so the deploy built from committed code only
deployed_from.run_by: Alex, in his own terminal, both times
deployed_from.command: make deploy CHECKPOINT_D=confirmed, with CDK set to aws-cdk@2.1142.0 on the command line
deployed_from.update_command_added: -c calmframes:signingKeyParameter=/calm-frames/cloud-signing-key, inside the CDK variable, because scripts/aws_guard.sh had no way to pass it
deployed_from.iam_changes_approved_by: Alex, typing y at the CDK prompt, which needs a terminal (TTY)

cdk.why_the_pin_was_overridden: CLI 2.1032.0 cannot read the cloud assembly that aws-cdk-lib 2.270.0 writes (schema 54). 2.1142.0 is the minimum CLI version the library's bundled cloud assembly schema declares.
cdk.ecs_service_linked_role_note: created before the first deploy. ECS had never been used in the account, and a first cluster made by CloudFormation without that role is reported to fail, which would have rolled back the whole stack, CloudFront distribution included.
cdk.pinned_cli_error: This CDK CLI is not compatible with the CDK library used by your application. Please upgrade the CLI to the latest version. (Cloud assembly schema version mismatch: Maximum schema version supported is 48.x.x, but found 54.0.0. You need at least CLI version 2.1142.0 to read this manifest.)

stack.update_reason: wire the cloud demo signing key in: the task definition names one SSM SecureString parameter and the task role may read only that one

IngestTaskTaskRoleDefaultPolicy: the task role's policy, two statements added

stack.oidc_note: githubRepo was left empty on purpose, so the stack made no GitHub OIDC provider and no deploy role. No workflow in this repository deploys.

iam_approval.counted_from: Alex's terminal output of the first make deploy: every row marked + in each of the three tables the CDK printed before asking
iam_approval.count_note: The rehearsal before the deploy predicted 19 statement rows. Alex's saved terminal output has 20 rows marked +, in 17 bordered groups, and 20 is what he approved.

budget.name: calm-frames-monthly
budget.what_that_means: Cost Explorer did not list Project as a cost allocation tag. A new tag can take up to a day to show up there after it is first put on a resource, and then it has to be activated in Billing. Until it is active the budget's tag filter matches no cost, so its alarms cannot fire.

scan_on_push.note: Every finding is in a Debian package from the base image or the pinned ffmpeg install, not in the Python packages, which pip-audit reports separately.

image.build_context_note: The pushed image carries pipeline/infra/cdk.context.json, the CDK lookup cache the deploy wrote into the worktree minutes earlier. It holds an availability zone lookup keyed by the account id. .dockerignore now excludes it.

signing_key.kind: cloud demo key, made for this deploy and nothing else
signing_key.generated_with: flashmap keygen, by Claude's session, into ~/.calm-frames/keys/cloud_demo_2026-10.pem, outside the repository
signing_key.store: SSM Parameter Store SecureString, standard tier, encrypted with the account's aws/ssm KMS key
task_role_may: kms:Decrypt only when the call arrives through SSM in us-east-1
signing_key.app_trusted_key_is: OFFLINE_PUBLIC_KEY_BASE64 in app/src/calmframes/offlineTitle.ts, the key the app checks general maps against
signing_key.why_the_app_refuses_its_maps: The app accepts a map only when its key equals a key compiled into the build. The cloud key's id matches none of the five compared here, so a map it signed is refused as an unknown key and the picture stays hidden.

runs.last_log_line: verify did not pass for 1c57cfe921ca (status 'failed'), so nothing is published
runs.what_it_shows: With no signing key in the cloud the task did the whole analysis and then refused to publish. That is the fail closed rule working on AWS, not a fault.

cost_note: Everything here is on the account's normal bill. The budget's 0.0 USD actual spend at 02:50 PDT says nothing yet, because of the inactive tag above.
teardown_leftovers: two /aws/lambda log groups that the CDK custom resource handlers created at run time, outside the stack, with no retention set
